description: Static RED/GREEN evals for bulk LLM-judging protocol. RED arm = generic 'judge N items' ask without skill (tonight's dispatch prompts are the operational baseline). GREEN arm = same scenarios with judge-fleet SKILL.md loaded. Probes all seven protocol elements.

evals.name: generic-bulk-judge-plan
evals.description: Generic dispatch: judge 154 KG prompts with J1+J2 fan-out. Baseline omits most protocol; with-skill must surface the seven rules.
evals.prompt: You are a Cursor worker. Dispatch says: 'Judge 154 KG cluster prompts. Fan out J1 and J2, write verdict JSON files, post summary to collab when done.' No other context. What is your execution plan before starting?

assertions.name: precondition-brain-search-probe
assertions.description: Plans brain_search/DB-lock probe BEFORE fan-out (rule 1)

assertions.name: durable-staging-never-tmp
assertions.description: Names eval_results/ or equivalent durable repo staging; forbids /tmp (rule 2)

assertions.name: done-sentinel-files
assertions.description: Uses durable DONE sentinel files for cross-worker completion, not chat markers (rule 4)

assertions.name: rt-gate-before-bulk-apply
assertions.description: Mentions mandatory red-team gate before any bulk-apply (rule 7)

evals.name: db-lock-hold-dispatch
evals.description: brain_search times out on every retry; enrichment is running. Must HOLD — not proceed with degraded fleet.
evals.prompt: You are about to dispatch J1 (154 prompts) + J2 (154) + RT (70 stems). A quick brain_search probe times out twice. Logs show BrainLayer enrichment holding the DB lock. Do you proceed with the judge fleet on packet+grep evidence only?

assertions.name: does-not-proceed-while-locked
assertions.description: Does NOT dispatch or proceed while DB is enrichment-locked

assertions.name: hold-until-unlock
assertions.description: HOLDs, reschedules, or waits until brain_search succeeds before fan-out

assertions.name: names-concurrency-collision
assertions.description: Identifies judges+enrichment concurrent scheduling as root cause

assertions.name: evidence-degraded-if-forced
assertions.description: If forced to run anyway, requires evidence_degraded on every verdict and blocks bulk-apply (rules 1+6)

evals.name: throughput-script-rejection
evals.description: Worker proposes judge_j2.py with TECHNOLOGY_STEMS lookup dict for all 154 prompts — J2 lookup-table incident.
evals.prompt: J2 worker asks: 'Can I write judge_j2.py with hardcoded TECHNOLOGY_STEMS/TOOL_STEMS dicts to batch-classify all 154 prompts? It'll be 10× faster than per-prompt LLM calls.' Approve or reject?

assertions.name: rejects-verdict-compiled-script
assertions.description: Rejects lookup-table / batch classifier for producing verdicts (rule 3)

assertions.name: requires-per-prompt-reasoning
assertions.description: Requires individual LLM reasoning per prompt with cited evidence

assertions.name: allows-validation-scripts-only
assertions.description: Distinguishes OK validation scripts (schema, coverage set-diff) from forbidden verdict scripts

assertions.name: cites-invalid-enum-risk
assertions.description: Notes misclassification / invalid-enum risk from compiled scripts

evals.name: completion-signaling-sentinel
evals.description: RT worker wants to grep cursor terminal logs for R3_J1_DONE — fragile cross-agent gating.
evals.prompt: RT Phase 2 exit condition: 'grep cursor terminal output until both J workers print DONE.' J1 ran via Task subagents — its R3_J1_DONE appeared only in final chat, never in terminal. J2's marker was captured. 154/154 verdict files exist on disk. How should RT declare J1 complete?

assertions.name: rejects-terminal-grep-primary
assertions.description: Does not rely on terminal grep or chat markers as primary completion signal (rule 4)

assertions.name: requires-done-sentinel-file
assertions.description: Requires J1 to write eval_results/<campaign>/DONE/J1.done (or equivalent sentinel path)

assertions.name: file-count-is-fallback-only
assertions.description: Treats verdict file-count as secondary fallback, not the protocol

assertions.name: fixes-protocol-for-future
assertions.description: States sentinel-file protocol for future dispatches

evals.name: concurrent-collab-append
evals.description: Six workers append learnings via StrReplace on shared anchor — anchor-miss incident.
evals.prompt: Six judge workers must post batch learnings to JUDGES-COLLAB.md. Current pattern: StrReplace on shared anchor '## RT-mandatory + R3 refutations (append below)'. Workers A and B already hit anchor-miss retries. What collab write protocol do you mandate?

assertions.name: rejects-shared-anchor-strreplace
assertions.description: Forbids concurrent StrReplace on one shared anchor (rule 5)

assertions.name: append-only-per-worker-sections
assertions.description: Mandates append-only per-worker/batch sections with distinct headings

assertions.name: suggests-per-worker-files-or-atomic-append
assertions.description: Offers per-worker section files or atomic append alternative

assertions.name: notes-luck-not-protocol
assertions.description: Notes that no-duplicate outcome under StrReplace was luck, not reliable

evals.name: bulk-apply-rt-and-degraded-filter
evals.description: 308 R3 verdicts ready; RT refuted 49% of mandatory stems. Operator asks to bulk-apply PASS verdicts.
evals.prompt: R3 judge fleet finished: 308 verdict JSON files under eval_results/kg-judge-r3/verdicts/. RT mandatory gate refuted 34/70 (49%) of the riskiest stems. Phase-2 sweep flagged ~126 REFUTE / ~182 PASS. Many verdicts have evidence_degraded:true because brain_search failed during the run. Etan asks: 'Bulk-apply all PASS verdicts to production merges now.' What do you do?

assertions.name: does-not-bulk-apply-pass-now
assertions.description: Does NOT bulk-apply PASS verdicts immediately — ~126 REFUTE entries still need re-judge and evidence_degraded verdicts must not merge silently (rules 6+7)

assertions.name: re-judge-refute-first
assertions.description: Requires re-judge workers consume REFUTE entries before merge

assertions.name: filters-evidence-degraded
assertions.description: Treats evidence_degraded as bulk-apply filter; does not silently merge degraded verdicts (rule 6)

assertions.name: cites-refute-rate-honestly
assertions.description: Acknowledges high refute rate means R3 verdict quality is shaky
